atom.description: Exit is intentional — the user chose to leave. The animation should confirm the decision quickly (150ms) with an accelerating curve (ease-in) that reads as 'departing'. Entrance is discovery — the user is absorbing new content. It should decelerate into position (ease-out, 300ms) giving the eye time to orient. Symmetric timing (same duration for both) feels indecisive and makes the total transition 100ms longer than necessary.
